prompt: Looking at the bike that is closest to the camera and assuming that it is not secured with a bike lock or tied to the bike rack in any way, what is the first action you have to take on the bike in order to remove it from the rack?
golden_response: The first action would need to be rotating the front wheel. The front wheel of the bike is hooked over the top metal bar. There is a fairly small open space between the wheel and the bike frame. The wheel should therefore be rotated in either direction to widen the distance between the wheel and the frame before pulling it backward. This also avoids having the front wheel roll higher up on the bar, which would increase the vertical distance between the person removing it and the handlebar.

rubric.title: States that the first action to remove the bike from the bike rack would be to rotate the front wheel.
